description: This header file defines the RpcMethods class, which provides RPC method implementations for a test management system. It includes method declarations for various RPC calls related to device management, system diagnostics, logging, and configuration, along with static member variables and method bindings.

classes.name: RpcMethods
classes.description: A class providing implementations for various RPC methods used in device and system management within the test framework.

methods.name: RPCExecuteTestCase
methods.description: Executes a specified test case via RPC.

methods.name: RPCGetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the device or system.

methods.name: RPCLoadModule
methods.description: Loads a module into the system.

methods.name: RPCUnloadModule
methods.description: Unloads a module from the system.

methods.name: RPCRestorePreviousState
methods.description: Restores the system to a previous state.

methods.name: RPCGetAgentConsoleLogPath
methods.description: Gets the log path for the agent console.

methods.name: RPCuploadLog
methods.description: Uploads logs with specified filenames and URL.
